ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Amount_Collected__c <> ROUND(Amount_Offered__c * VALUE(Ratio__c),0) && (RecordType.Name = 'Working Capital Oppty') && (Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'National Funding - Gold WC Funding' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'National Funding - Diamond WC Funding' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'National Funding - Platinum WC Funding' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'National Funding - Commercial WC Funding' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'Advance Me, Inc (Merchant)' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'New Logic Business Loans (NL Only)') && (ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Docs Out - MCA")) && DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) >= DATE(2014,10,28)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Amount Collected must be equal to the Amount Doc'd multiplied by the WC Sell Rate, rounded to the nearest dollar.
